episodes.title: The Porch Light
episodes.hook: At 17, he said, “Don’t wait up, Mom.”

episodes.title: The Lunchbox Note
episodes.hook: He found a note from his mom in the lunch he packed himself.

episodes.title: The Shoes by the Door
episodes.hook: She kept his old sneakers exactly where he left them.

episodes.title: The Umbrella
episodes.hook: He was grown when he noticed she was still getting wet for him.

episodes.title: One More Story
episodes.hook: He used to ask for one more story. Then one day, he was too busy.

episodes.title: The Missed Call
episodes.hook: He almost ignored her call. Then he heard why she called.

episodes.title: His First Paycheck
episodes.hook: The first thing he bought with his own money was for her.

episodes.title: The Blue Mug
episodes.hook: She saved the chipped mug because it was his favorite.

episodes.title: The School Photo
episodes.hook: She still kept the picture he hated taking.

episodes.title: The Long Drive
episodes.hook: He thought the quiet car ride meant she had nothing to say.

episodes.title: The Empty Room
episodes.hook: His childhood room changed. One thing never did.

episodes.title: The Voice Message
episodes.hook: He saved her ordinary voice message for an extraordinary reason.

episodes.title: Learning to Text
episodes.hook: Her message had six spelling mistakes and one perfect question.

episodes.title: The Broken Toy
episodes.hook: He brought home the kind of problem she used to fix with tape.

episodes.title: Sunday Call
episodes.hook: Their Sunday calls were short—until one of them wasn’t.

episodes.title: A Place at the Table
episodes.hook: She set one extra plate, even when he said he might not come.

episodes.title: The Recipe
episodes.hook: He finally asked how she made the dish he had loved all his life.

episodes.title: The Unsent Letter
episodes.hook: While packing, he found the letter she never meant him to read.

episodes.title: Walking Beside Her
episodes.hook: One day, he noticed she was walking a little slower.

episodes.title: His Turn to Leave the Light On
episodes.hook: This time, she was the one coming home late.

followUpSeries.title: Love Before Likes
followUpSeries.premise: Original, 1990s-inspired love stories told through letters, landlines, mixtapes, and missed connections.

ideas.title: The Cassette Tape
ideas.hook: He recorded her favorite song, but left the last ten seconds blank.

ideas.title: One Phone at Home
ideas.hook: They had one chance to talk before her family returned.

ideas.title: The Library Note
ideas.hook: She found his reply tucked inside the same book a week later.

ideas.title: The Missed Bus
ideas.hook: He missed the bus on purpose. She knew, but never told him.

ideas.title: The Photo Booth Strip
ideas.hook: Four tiny pictures survived a love story no one expected to end.
